data.key: Unchained Rogue Talent ~ Master of Disguise
data.name: Master of Disguise
data.description: Once per day, a rogue with this talent can don a disguise as a standard action. While wearing that disguise, she gains a +10 bonus on all Disguise checks. A rogue must have the Quick Disguise talent to select this talent.
